description.value: Westward Ho! is a public house and bar & grill situated within the University Golf Club on Vancouver's west side, open to the general public and not restricted to golfers. It features a first-come, first-served outdoor patio and a varied menu spanning pub classics and brunch options. Cyclists exploring the UBC and University Endowment Lands area will find it a full-service dining stop with a relaxed clubhouse atmosphere.
